exposure: intervention for kidney stones during pregnancy
cohort: 1.39 million pregnancies in Ontario from 2004 to 2014
finding: Pregnancies complicated by kidney stones had an increased risk for adverse birth outcomes, including pre-eclampsia and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Pregnancies complicated by kidney stones had a greater risk for cesarean section compared to matched pregnancies without stones (OR 1.39, 95% CI 1.27-1.51, p < 0.0001).
